review_candidates.title: 医疗器械制造工程师 - 高级
review_candidates.company: 上海医学生命科学研究中心有限公司
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 负责产品转移及新产品导入制造环节的各项工作：统筹制造活动，通过工艺优化、产品持续改进等举措达成首检合格率目标及整体生产目标；主导测试夹具与设备的改进、维护及校准工作；负责制造工艺验证、工程变更管理等关键技术工作，保障制造流程的稳定性与合规性。 1. 产品转移（海外）——20%：主导海外新/现有产品向本土制造端到端转移，对接研发、供应链、QC、生产等跨团队对齐技术规格与工艺要求；梳理技术壁垒及流程差异并制定解决方案，统筹试产、工艺调试及量产，保障产品顺利落地并达产能。 2. 生产线搭建、制造/QC测试管理——30%：结合工艺与产能需求，完成生产线布局、设备选型及流程规划以提效；统筹制造及QC测试全流程，明确质量控制点与测试规范，巡检并解决设备适配、流程衔接问题，确保测试符合产品标准。 3. 首检合格率（FPY）目标达成——10%：将首检合格率提升作为核心业绩指标。通过生产数据复盘、缺陷统计分析等方式，精准定位影响合格率的关键因素（如工艺参数偏差、设备精度不足、操作不规范等）。制定并落地改进措施，建立合格率动态监控机制，持续推动指标达成或超越。 4. 工程变更（EC）管理及工艺验证/确认——10%：主导制造端工程变更的全流程管理，从变更申请评估、影响分析，到方案制定、执行落地及效果验证全环节闭环管控。牵头开展工艺验证与确认工作，制定IQ（安装确认）、OQ（运行确认）、PQ（性能确认）方案并组织实施，确保变更后的工艺满足产品质量要求且具备稳定性；同步更新相关工艺文件，协调跨团队完成变更切换。 5. 失效分析(pFMEA)及纠正/预防措施（CAPA）制定——10%：针对生产过程中的产品失效、工艺异常及客户反馈的质量问题，开展根源分析（如采用鱼骨图、5Why等方法）。结合分析结果制定并推动纠正措施落地，同时识别潜在风险点制定预防方案，形成CAPA管理。 6. 流程文件编制及培训——10%：负责编制、修订和维护制造全流程的规范性文件，包括生产工艺规程、作业指导书、检验规范等，确保文件的准确性、完整性和可操作性。基于文件要求及岗位需求，设计并开展培训。 7. 测试夹具及设备的预防性维护/校准——10%：建立测试夹具、生产设备的全生命周期管理体系，制定科学的预防性维护计划（含维护周期、内容、责任人）并组织执行，减少设备突发故障对生产的影响。统筹设备及夹具的校准工作，对接外部校准机构或组织内部校准，制定校准计划、记录校准数据，确保设备及夹具的精度满足工艺要求，且校准过程符合行业规范。 经验要求： 熟悉ISO 9001/13485标准要求、风险管理、pFEMA、精益生产、六西格玛及5S管理。 精通机械图纸与几何尺寸公差（GD&T），分析公差、识别关键尺寸。 离散制造环境和新产品导入/转移工作经验，优先考虑生命科学或医疗器械行业背景，同时负责多条产品线的制造良率目标达成、避免生产线停机等职责。 机械工程相关领域工作经验，工程变更请求/订单管理经验，物料清单创建与维护经验。 具备微孔板PCR检测试剂配制实践经验。

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职位描述： 1. 负责华东区域整车厂、汽车Tier1、车规芯片厂商、智能驾驶企业的开发与维护，挖掘汽车安全认证相关业务需求，搭建稳定的区域客户合作体系； 2. 基于ISO 26262、ISO 21434、ISO 21448、ISO 8800等汽车高阶安全标准，对接客户功能安全、网络安全、预期功能安全、车载AI安全的咨询、认证等业务，负责主导商务洽谈、报价签约等工作； 3. 熟悉华东市场汽车、车载芯片行业动态，梳理区域客户分布、产业特点及竞品情况，制定适配的区域拓展策略，完善区域资源布局； 4. 联动公司技术及后台团队跟进项目落地，协调解决项目问题，保障项目顺利交付，提升客户留存与复购； 5. 定期整理区域业务数据、客户痛点及行业标准动态，输出市场分析内容，优化拓展模式，推动区域业务规模化增长； 6.其他上级主管安排的任务。 职位要求： 1. 本科及以上学历，车辆工程、电子信息、软件工程等相关专业优先；3年以上相关行业工作经验； 2. 熟悉四大汽车高阶安全标准商业化模式及落地场景，可精准匹配客户合规需求； 3. 深耕华东汽车产业，熟悉区域整车厂、Tier1、车载芯片企业分布、业务特点及合作模式，有优质本地客户资源者优先； 4. 熟悉汽车电子、智能驾驶及车载芯片产业链，了解汽车安全合规、技术咨询行业商业模式与项目落地流程； 5. 具备优秀的商务谈判、需求挖掘及客户维系能力，市场敏感度高、抗压性强，有汽车行业BD经验者优先； 6. 可适应华东区域短期出差，沟通能力良好，具备团队协作意识与职业素养。

review_candidates.description: Стратегическое управление: Разработка и реализация стратегии развития филиала, цифровой трансформаций. в регионе с учетом локальной специфики рынка. Выполнение KPI: Операционное руководство: Контроль за бесперебойной работой всех подразделений филиала (ИТ тех поддержка, клиентский сервис, административный отдел). Развитие бизнеса: Поиск новых точек роста, расширение клиентской базы, установление и укрепление партнерских отношений с ключевыми клиентами и дочерними организаций КМГ в Мангистауской, Актюбинской области. Управление командой: Финансовый контроль: Утверждение и контроль бюджета филиала, оптимизация расходов, управление дебиторской задолженностью. Отчетность: Формирование регулярной управленческой и финансовой отчетности для головного офиса. Требования к кандидатам Опыт работы: От 3–5 лет на руководящих позициях (Директор филиала, Коммерческий директор, Региональный менеджер) в ИТ компаниях. Навыки: Успешный опыт стратегического планирования, антикризисного управления, бюджетирования и выстраивания бизнес-процессов «с нуля» или их глубокой оптимизации. Понимание рынка: Знание специфики ведения бизнеса в Западном Казахстане (г. Актау и Мангистауская область) будет существенным преимуществом. Личные качества: Лидерские качества, развитые навыки ведения переговоров на высшем уровне, ориентация на результат, высокая степень ответственности, стрессоустойчивость. Образование: Высшее (экономическое, управленческое или техническое); наличие MBA или дополнительных бизнес-образований приветствуется.

review_candidates.title: Warranty Specialist to BYD Passenger Cars Denmark
review_candidates.company: BYD EUROPE
review_candidates.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: About BYD Our Purpose is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature. We are looking for talent that connects with this mission and want to create positive impact by joining a diverse and dynamic team. BYD is a leading, high-tech multinational, based in Shenzhen, China. Operates in four core fields of IT, automotive, new energy, and rail transit and employs over 800,000 people worldwide. As a global pioneer in New Energy Solutions BYD is dedicated to building a zero-emission ecosystem. About BYD Denmark BYD Denmark is the Danish National Sales Company of BYD BV Europe and BYD Company Ltd, a China-based company and a leading global supplier of green energy technologies. BYD Denmark offers a range of electric vehicles, including all-electric cars, buses & forklifts. BYD is expanding its operations in Denmark to support a growing network of workshops and a growing number cars on the Danish roads. About The Role As a Warranty Specialist , your mission is to ensure an efficient, accurate, and customer-focused warranty operation, providing high-quality support to customers and Service Providers while maximizing customer satisfaction. You will ensure warranty claims are processed in line with company policies, identify opportunities for process improvement, and contribute to building a best-in-class warranty operation through strong data analysis, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Review and verify warranty claims and reports, ensuring accurate and timely processing of warranty reimbursements in accordance with warranty policies and procedures. Collect, analyze, and report warranty-related data, identifying trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for operational improvement. Provide support to Service Providers by responding to warranty inquiries, clarifying policies, and ensuring a clear understanding of warranty requirements and processes. Investigate abnormal or complex warranty cases, conduct regular audits, and implement corrective actions to improve claim quality and compliance. Manage warranty parts, including the auditing, tracking, storage, and disposal process in accordance with company procedures. Support special warranty events, material verification activities, and other warranty-related projects and processes. Organize and deliver on-site warranty training sessions for Service Providers, working closely with relevant internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Customer Service, Aftersales, Technical, Finance, and other relevant departments to ensure efficient resolution of warranty-related topics. Identify process gaps and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of warranty operations. Prepare regular reports and presentations for management, providing clear insights into warranty performance and key operational indicators. Perform other warranty-related activities and projects as assigned by the line manager. Skills, Qualifications, and Experience Required: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in warranty, or related aftersales operations. High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize under pressure. Customer-oriented mindset with a proactive and analytical approach. Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with SAP and Warehouse Management Systems is an advantage. Fluent in Danish and English (spoken and written); Mandarin or other European languages are a plus. We Offer: Competitive remuneration based on performance and experience. Opportunities for department and company-wide team building events. A chance to contribute to the transition towards zero-emission transportation and the decarbonization of the economy. If you align with our mission and have the skills we need, apply to be our Warranty Specialist in Denmark today. Join us in our journey towards a sustainable future! Location: Copenhagen, Denmark Type of Employment: Full-time

review_candidates.company: Kpler
review_candidates.description: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. Total Rewards Analyst The Total Rewards Analyst supports the delivery of Kpler’s global compensation and benefits programmes, combining strong analytical capability with hands-on benefits management. The role will take day-to-day ownership of key benefits activities while supporting compensation benchmarking, salary analysis, annual reward cycles and market research. Working closely with the Head of Compensation & Benefits, People Operations, HR Business Partners, Payroll and external providers, the role will help ensure Kpler’s reward programmes are competitive, well-governed and delivered consistently across our global locations. Key Responsibilities Global Benefits Management Support the day-to-day management of Kpler’s global benefits programmes across multiple countries. Manage employee and dependent enrolments, changes and benefit queries, working closely with People Operations where appropriate. Maintain the global benefits inventory, renewal calendar and key programme documentation. Coordinate insurance renewals, ensuring data, documentation and approvals are completed within required timelines. Partner with brokers, insurers and benefit providers to resolve operational issues and maintain service standards. Support implementation of benefits in new countries and entities. Support the transition to and ongoing management of Kpler’s global benefits broker. Review benefit invoices and employee data to support accurate administration and cost management. Maintain benefits SOPs, controls and documentation to reduce key-person dependency and strengthen governance. Support regional benefits benchmarking and identify opportunities to improve competitiveness, consistency and cost effectiveness. Compensation & Reward Analysis Support global salary benchmarking and market-data analysis. Participate in annual compensation survey submissions and maintain accurate market- matching data. Support job and role mapping against external market benchmarks. Analyse employee compensation against salary ranges, market data and internal peers. Produce compa-ratio, range-positioning, internal-equity and pay-gap analysis. Support departmental compensation reviews and recommendations. Support annual merit, promotion and compensation review cycles. Assist with compensation analysis required for EU Pay Transparency readiness. Conduct compensation and benefits research for new markets as Kpler expands. Prepare clear analysis and recommendations for HRBPs, business leaders and Total Rewards Governance & Reporting Maintain accurate and auditable compensation and benefits data. Produce regular reporting on benefits costs, renewals, employee participation and compensation positioning. Identify data inconsistencies, operational risks and areas requiring escalation. Support development and maintenance of Total Rewards policies, processes and SOPs. Partner with People Operations and Payroll to ensure compensation and benefits changes are implemented accurately Skills & Experience Approximately 4-8 years' experience in Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, Reward or a related analytical HR role. Practical experience administering employee benefits, ideally across multiple countries. Experience working with brokers, insurers or benefits providers. Strong numerical and analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills. Exposure to compensation benchmarking, salary ranges, market data or compensation review processes. Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with sensitive employee and compensation data. Comfortable managing multiple deadlines, renewals and operational priorities simultaneously. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Able to identify problems, investigate root causes and work independently towards solutions.
